title: Oven Baked Norwegian Feta Pasta
description: A fresh and fluffy ovo-vegetarian Norwegian dish featuring cubed feta cheese, served on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and minced garlic.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss to combine with the oil mixture.
Add the cubed feta cheese, halved cherry tomatoes, and chopped parsley to the bowl and toss gently.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a slate tile vessel or a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
